verdict.heading: What this actually is
verdict.intro: Not a course, not an app you log into, not a monthly plan. It is a single ZIP file you own. Extract it, open one HTML page, and five ministry tools and eleven books work on your computer whether or not you have a connection — and whether or not we are still trading in five years.

dives.heading: What each tool does
dives.intro: These are working tools, not demos. Each one saves as you type, and each has Save a copy and Load a copy so you can back your work up or move it to another computer.

products.name: FaithSteps
products.summary: Guided spiritual journeys and faith-building pathways. This is the tool you reach for when someone in your care is walking through a hard season and you want to give them something structured to work through, rather than a well-meant sentence and a hug.
specs: Save a copy / Load a copy
pros: Gives you something concrete to hand to someone struggling
Structured enough to use without preparation
No printing, no internet, no accounts
cons: It is a guide, not a replacement for pastoral conversation
Plain, functional interface rather than a polished app
products.forWho: Pastors and ministry leaders discipling someone through a specific season.

products.name: Daily Grace Planner
products.summary: Plan your day around prayer, rather than fitting prayer into whatever is left of your day. For anyone in ministry, the second version is how the first version quietly stops happening.
pros: Addresses the real failure mode of ministry schedules
Takes seconds to use each morning
Nothing to sync or sign into
cons: You still have to open it
products.forWho: Anyone in ministry whose prayer life has been squeezed out by their to-do list.

products.name: Bible Study
products.summary: Ready-to-run studies with a journal that keeps your answers. Lead a small group without spending your week building the material first, and keep what people said so you can follow up on it.
pros: Removes the prep work of running a group
Answers stay private on your machine
cons: Studies are written for Christian small groups, so they are not neutral material
You will want to adapt some questions to your own congregation
products.forWho: Anyone leading a Bible study, small group or discipleship class.

products.name: Sermon Outline Builder
products.summary: Build a preachable outline, offline, in minutes. Structure your points, order them, and get to a shape you can actually preach from — without a word processor or a distraction one tab away.
pros: Offline means no browser tabs pulling you away
Fast route from idea to preachable shape
cons: An outline builder, not a full manuscript editor
Your theology still has to come from you
products.forWho: Pastors and preachers preparing weekly sermons.

products.name: Pastor's Assistant
products.summary: A prayer centre, a visit log and ministry admin in one place. This is the tool that holds the most sensitive notes you keep — who you visited, what they asked you to pray for, what is happening in their family — and none of it leaves your computer.
pros: Prayer requests and pastoral notes stay on your own machine
One place instead of a notebook, a phone and a spreadsheet
No cloud service holding your congregation's confidences
cons: Because it is offline by design, it will not sync between your devices — use Save a copy to move it
Losing the file without a backup loses the records
products.forWho: Pastors who keep pastoral notes and take the confidentiality of them seriously.

points.p: A year of daily readings for couples pursuing their calling and their family together. The longest book in the library, and the one to start with if you are married.

Written for single believers under pressure to settle, or to treat singleness as a waiting room rather than a season.

points.h: Forgiving Forward — Releasing Resentment and Finding Freedom
points.p: On what to do with a grudge you have decided you are entitled to keep.

points.h: Loving Like Jesus — Living Out the Gospel in Every Relationship

points.h: God's Blueprint for a Strong Christian Marriage
points.p: A biblical guide to building love, trust and unity that lasts. Pairs naturally with Undivided.
For parents raising children to love God in a culture that is not helping.
Bible accounts that draw you closer to God — a good starting point for newer believers.

points.h: Unusual Obedience — When God Asks the Unexpected
points.p: For anyone at a crossroads where the instruction does not match the plan they had.

points.h: The Christian Journey — Holiness and Integrity
points.p: Foundational teaching on walking in holiness and integrity when it costs something.

proof.heading: Read this before you buy
proof.intro: £147 is a real amount of money and you should know exactly what you are and are not getting. Here is the honest version.

cards.p: The eleven books are written by Pastor Mega Philip Mega and most are also sold individually in our store. You are buying a library that exists, not a bundle assembled to look like one.
One ZIP file, about 7.5 MB. Extract it and double-click START-HERE.html. There is no server to go down, no account to expire and no subscription to cancel.
Prayer requests and visit notes never leave your computer. That is a privacy design decision, not a marketing line — there is genuinely nowhere for the data to be sent.

proof.slotNote: This is where reviews from pastors and ministry leaders go. We have none to quote yet, so rather than invent them the space stays empty. Send me real ones and they drop straight in — for a £147 product, a single honest quote does more than any headline.

faq.q: Is £147 a one-off payment, or a subscription?
faq.a: A one-off payment. There is no subscription, no renewal, no account and no seat count. You pay once, you download the ZIP, and it keeps working. Version 1.0.0 is what you get today; future editions with new books and tools are released separately rather than pushed to you automatically.

faq.q: Does it really work with no internet?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is inside the ZIP file — the tools, the books and the page that opens them. Once it is on your computer you do not need a connection to use any of it, and nothing stops working if a connection is unavailable.

faq.q: What do I actually need to run it?
faq.a: Any modern browser on Windows, Mac or Linux. There is nothing to install. Extract the ZIP, double-click START-HERE.html, and every tool and book is one click away. A plain-English README is included that covers the one Windows step and explains how your work is kept.

faq.q: Where do my notes and prayer requests go?
faq.a: Nowhere. Nothing you type leaves your computer. There is no account, no sign-in and no cloud service, so prayer requests and visit notes about the people you shepherd stay with you. Every tool saves as you type, and each has Save a copy and Load a copy so you can back up your work or move it to another computer.

faq.q: Can I read the books on my Kindle?
faq.a: The books are EPUB files, which open in Apple Books, Google Play Books, Kobo, Calibre, Adobe Digital Editions and the Kindle app. They are yours to keep and read on whichever you already use.

faq.q: Can I buy the books on their own instead?
faq.a: Yes. Ten of the eleven books are sold individually in our store, from £3.99, if you want to read one before committing to the suite. The five tools and the book The Driver are only available inside the suite. Buying the ten individual books separately adds up to £48.80 — so the suite is £147 for those books, the eleventh, and the five tools together.

faq.q: What if it is not right for me?
faq.a: Message us at megaphilip76@gmail.com or on +44 7869 160958 and tell us what you need. If the suite is not it, we would rather tell you honestly than take £147 for something that sits unused.

finalVerdict.heading: Who this is for, and who it is not
finalVerdict.intro: Being straight about this saves us both time. If you recognise yourself in the left column, buy it. If you recognise yourself on the right, do not.
